prompt_text: What is the best home care agency in Pleasanton CA for an elderly parent?
ai_overview_text:
Several top-rated home care and home health agencies serve Pleasanton, California, depending on whether your parent needs non-medical daily assistance or clinical/medical care.
Services: Personal care, companionship, medication reminders, meal preparation, 24/7 care, and specialty programs for Alzheimer’s, dementia, Parkinson’s, and post-surgical recovery.
Accreditations: Home Care Pulse Certified, Great Place to Work Certified (2026–2027), and partner with the Aging Life Care Association and Parkinson’s Foundation.
Key Feature: Offers RightAssist passive monitoring technology and regular objective health reports.
Services: Skilled medical and clinical home health care services (best if your parent requires a visiting nurse, physical therapy, or doctor-ordered clinical treatment rather than just companion/personal aide support). Health US News
Medical vs. Non-Medical: Decide if your parent needs non-medical home care (bathing, dressing, meals, driving) or home health care (nursing, wound care, physical therapy prescribed by a physician). Care.com +2
Level of Supervision: Check whether you need a few hours a week, overnight care, or continuous 24-hour/live-in assistance. Visiting Angels +1
Specialized Needs: If your parent has dementia, Alzheimer's, or Parkinson's, look for agencies with specific staff training in memory care (such as Right at Home or Hillendale). Hillendale Home Care +1
Does your parent need non-medical help (companionship, personal care) or medical home health care (nurses, therapy)?
How many hours per day or week of care are you looking for?
Do they have specific conditions like dementia or post-surgery recovery?
